welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.description: Let's set up your first spending period. You'll learn how to use the app by doing, step by step.
welcome.bullet1: First, choose what you want to organize (a group).
welcome.bullet2: Then, define your expected expenses and register a real expense.
welcome.bullet3: Finally, compare what you planned with what you actually spent.

chooseGroup.title: What do you want to organize?
chooseGroup.description: A group is where your budgets live. You can create a new one or choose an existing one.

chooseCadence.title: Choose the cadence
chooseCadence.description: How often do you want your budget to repeat. You can change this later.

addExpectedExpenses.title: Define your expected expenses
addExpectedExpenses.description: Estimate how much you plan to spend in each category. This defines your budget.
addExpectedExpenses.needCategory: You need at least one category to add expected expenses.

budgetSummary.title: This is your budget
budgetSummary.description: The total of your expected expenses defines your budget for this period.

registerActualExpense.title: Register a real expense
registerActualExpense.description: Now that you have your budget, register a real expense to see how it works.
registerActualExpense.skipActual: I don't have real expenses yet

compareExpenses.title: Expected vs. Actual
compareExpenses.description: Here you can see the difference between what you planned and what you spent.
compareExpenses.explanation: If you spent less than expected, you'll see it in green. If you spent more, in red. This is the core idea of MiPlatita.
compareExpenses.noActual: You haven't registered any real expenses yet. No worries! You can start tracking them from the dashboard whenever you're ready.

dashboardTour.title: Get to know the dashboard
dashboardTour.description: The dashboard shows you a summary of all your budgets.
dashboardTour.tip1: Select a group and a budget to see the summary.
dashboardTour.tip2: The chart shows expected vs. actual at a glance.
dashboardTour.tip3: The recent expenses table shows what you last registered.

complete.title: All done!
complete.description: You've completed onboarding. You now know how to use MiPlatita.
